name: How long does it take to replace kitchen cabinets?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to replace kitchen cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for kitchen cabinet replacement typically ranges from 1 to 3 weeks, though this can vary. The duration depends on the scope of the project, whether you choose stock, semi-custom, or custom cabinets, and the availability of materials. Installation itself often takes a few days to a week, but the overall process includes design, ordering, demolition, and preparation. Custom cabinets naturally have longer lead times. Your contractor can provide a more precise schedule after understanding your specific choices.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replacement usually takes 1 to 3 weeks. This includes design, ordering, delivery, demolition, and installation. Custom cabinets may extend this timeline.
